headlines.title: Trump signs executive order waiving new Russia sanctions, tariffs
headlines.snippet: Donald Trump signed an executive order waiving new Russia sanctions and tariffs.

headlines.title: EU condemns Israeli occupier attacks on Palestinians, European diplomats in occupied West Bank
headlines.snippet: The EU has condemned attacks by Israeli occupiers on Palestinians and European diplomats in the West Bank, calling for accountability and an end to settlement expansion.

headlines.title: Egypt’s defense council pledges ‘all forms of support’ to defend Saudi Arabia amid escalating Houthi attacks
headlines.snippet: Egypt's National Defense Council has pledged 'all forms of support' to defend Saudi Arabia amid escalating Houthi attacks, linking Saudi national security to Egyptian and Arab security.

headlines.title: Egyptian parliament adjourns session on potential military support for Saudi Arabia
headlines.snippet: The Egyptian parliament has adjourned a session on potential military support for Saudi Arabia, with a second session scheduled for Monday.

headlines.title: Pakistani, Egyptian foreign ministers condemn Houthi attacks, reaffirm solidarity with Saudi Arabia
headlines.snippet: Pakistani and Egyptian foreign ministers have condemned Houthi attacks and reaffirmed solidarity with Saudi Arabia. Separately, Pakistan's top diplomat and Iran's counterpart discussed the regional situation by phone.

headlines.title: Egyptian parliament begins emergency session on possible troop deployment to defend Saudi Arabia
headlines.snippet: The Egyptian parliament has convened an emergency session concerning possible troop deployment to defend Saudi Arabia, following President Sisi's earlier statement of Cairo's readiness to provide support if requested by Riyadh.

headlines.title: Vietnam, EFTA nations sign free trade deal
headlines.snippet: Vietnam and four non-EU European nations have signed a free trade agreement in Hanoi, aiming to diversify markets and strengthen cooperation.

headlines.title: UN chief decries ‘discouraging’ steps in Cyprus
headlines.snippet: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres responded to a letter from the presidency of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC).

headlines.title: Fugitive members of terrorist FETÖ nabbed in Istanbul
headlines.snippet: Istanbul police have apprehended three fugitive members of the Gülenist Terror Group (FETÖ), including one who had been on the run for ten years.
